getTokens(address,bytes32[]).details: Fetch up token information with token IDs. If a token contract does not implement the decimals() function, its decimals field will be 0.

params._t2crAddress: The address of the t2cr contract from where to fetch token information.
params._tokenIDs: The IDs of the tokens we want to query.

params._count: The number of items to iterate.
params._cursor: The index from where to start iterating.
params._filter: The filter to use. Each element of the array in sequence means: - Include absent addresses in result. - Include registered addresses in result. - Include addresses with registration requests that are not disputed in result. - Include addresses with clearing requests that are not disputed in result. - Include disputed addresses with registration requests in result. - Include disputed addresses with clearing requests in result.
params._t2crAddress: The address of the t2cr contract from where to fetch token information.

getTokensIDsForAddresses(address,address.details: Fetch token IDs of the first tokens present on the tcr for the addresses.

params._t2crAddress: The address of the t2cr contract from where to fetch token information.
